title: Livelsberger email gives Area 51 coordinates for gravitic propulsion center

tellings.quote: this very weird email sent by Matthew displays the coordinates of America gravitic propulsions Operation Center the coordinates are at Area 51

plain: Michels says an email sent by a man named Matthew Livelsberger gave the map coordinates of America's 'gravitic propulsion' operations center, meaning a place that works on moving craft by controlling gravity, and that the coordinates point to Area 51, the secret Air Force test site in Nevada. Michels calls it 'this very weird email' and tells it himself in an episode with Randy Anderson, a man who says he saw alien technology at a military base. If it holds, it would put a working antigravity program at Area 51.
